purpose: Keep MIRA recurring work inside the smallest practical number of ChatGPT scheduled tasks while making Daily Cleanup and Daily Briefs understandable to normal users.
planner_order: add work as a phase of an existing MIRA scheduled task
add another execution time to an existing recurring MIRA task when one task can cover it
merge compatible Daily Cleanup and Daily Brief preparation
create another scheduled task only when no safe consolidation exists

feature_studio.friendly_checkbox: MIRA may need to organize new information later
feature_studio.friendly_explanation: Turn this on when new information may need MIRA to identify, categorize, match, summarize, or check it later.

manual_cleanup.chatgpt_mode: Open the user's MIRA ChatGPT destination with or copy a prepared request to process pending MIRROR cleanup work; do not call the OpenAI API from the app.
manual_cleanup.api_mode: When a user explicitly enables a metered API processor, an immediate processor may be offered with visible cost consequences.
manual_cleanup.manual_mode: Run deterministic work only and leave AI-required items in Review.
